R_did_canonical.verdict: Significant heterogeneity: high & mid-carbon show significant single-bidding REDUCTION (-16/-14pp), low-carbon null/positive (+6.8). Aggregate null is offsetting terciles. Caveat: high-carbon sectors also most concentrated (Fix5) -> cannot cleanly separate carbon from market structure; descriptive heterogeneity, not clean causal carbon-targeting.

HONESTDID_DOWNGRADE: High-carbon -16pp is aggregation-sensitive (dynamic-avg only -1.6pp) and NOT robust to pre-trend violations (HonestDiD unbounded for Mbar>=0.5). Report as suggestive carbon GRADIENT, not a robust high-carbon effect.
